♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon moves through mid-Virgo in Hasta, activating your 6th house of discipline, health and practical service. The Sun is bright in late Leo with Ketu in early Leo in your 5th, while Mars, your ruler, sits at 26° Gemini in Punarvasu in your 3rd. Jupiter remains exalted in Cancer in your 4th, and retrograde Saturn in Pisces pulls you inward through the 12th. This combination pushes you to translate restless ideas into concrete, doable actions that quietly stabilise your life.

💼 Career: The 3rd–6th axis is lit: this is about how you work day-to-day, not grand titles. You may feel compelled to reorganise tasks, create clearer checklists, or refine how you communicate with colleagues. Mars in your 3rd gives you courage to speak up about inefficient processes or confusing instructions, but keep your tone solution-focused rather than combative. Small improvements—like reworking a template, updating a workflow, or clarifying responsibilities—could make a visible difference in productivity by the end of the week.

❤️ Love: With Sun–Ketu in your 5th, your romantic life may feel less about drama and more about whether your connections fit your current rhythm. You may crave partners or dates who respect your busy schedule or even share your focus on self-improvement. If partnered, consider planning something simple yet intentional: a walk after work, cooking together, or co-working in the same space. If single, someone met through work, study, or wellness activities could catch your interest—not necessarily with fireworks, but with consistency and humour.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 4th continues to favour investments in home, family stability and emotional security, while Virgo Moon in the 6th highlights routine expenses tied to work and health. Today is suited to reviewing subscriptions, transport costs, or recurring bills and adjusting them to current realities. A modest upgrade in your tools, ergonomics, or daily environment can become more beneficial than a flashy, one-off purchase. Avoid impulsive spending tied to temporary frustration at work.

🧘 Advice: Treat your task list as a training ground for self-mastery, not a punishment. Choose one habit that, if improved, will make every future day easier.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The discipline you apply to the smallest corner of your life today quietly rewrites what you believe you’re capable of tomorrow.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through Virgo in Hasta in your 5th house, energising creativity, children, romance and self-expression. The Sun in Purva Phalguni in Leo still heats your 4th house of home and inner foundations, with Ketu in Magha stripping away what no longer feels emotionally true. Venus, your ruler, travels through Swati in Libra in your 6th, seeking grace and balance in daily routines. This blend strengthens your desire to make life both more beautiful and more functional.

💼 Career: With Venus in your 6th, you’re well-placed to smooth rough edges at work: easing tensions, making systems more user-friendly, or bringing aesthetic clarity to presentations and client interactions. The Virgo Moon in your 5th supports experimenting with new formats or approaches—perhaps a different way of explaining concepts or a playful tweak to branding or teaching. Think of today as a lab day: test one creative idea that also solves a practical problem. Collaborators who appreciate quality and fairness will respond well.

❤️ Love: The 4th–5th emphasis highlights the link between feeling safe and feeling playful. If partnered, you’re likely to crave cosy, affectionate time that also sparks your mind—board games, shared creative projects, or planning improvements at home. Honest conversations about what makes each of you feel “at home” emotionally can deepen trust. If single, your charm is amplified in down-to-earth settings: at work, in classes, volunteering, or in spaces where people are actively building something, not just passing time.

💰 Money: Jupiter in Cancer in your 3rd continues to support learning-based income and growth via skills, writing, teaching or local networks. Venus in the 6th suggests that spending on organisation, health, or efficiency—like a planner, ergonomic tools, or a short course—can be worthwhile, provided it genuinely gets used. Watch for subtle temptations to buy comfort when you’re actually craving inspiration; a reasonably priced creative outlet or hobby may satisfy you more than random treats.

🧘 Advice: Let practicality and pleasure shake hands. When your responsibilities feel a bit more like art, you won’t need to escape them as often.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The more you allow joy into the structure of your day, the less you’ll search for it in expensive escapes.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon in mid-Virgo in Hasta travels through your 4th house of home, roots and emotional grounding, while Mercury, your ruler, is exalted in Virgo in Uttara Phalguni, sharpening your perception of domestic and inner realities. The Sun in late Leo with Ketu in early Leo lights up your 3rd house of communication, siblings and short journeys. Mars in late Gemini charges your 1st house, giving you courage and restlessness in equal measure. Today’s sky pushes you to reorganise your base so your mind can operate more clearly.

💼 Career: This is an excellent day for behind-the-scenes thinking. With strong Virgo energy in your 4th, you’re supported in setting up systems at home or in your private workspace that will help you think and produce more efficiently—filing, backups, schedules, or a clearer division between work and rest. Sun–Ketu in your 3rd may reveal which conversations, chats or apps are simply noise. Cutting down on mental clutter will improve your output more than adding more commitments. Mars in your sign can help you initiate a key discussion with a colleague or supervisor—just be deliberate, not hasty.

❤️ Love: Emotional sensitivity is heightened, but so is your capacity to express what you’re feeling in precise, respectful language. If partnered, discussions about living arrangements, family boundaries, or shared domestic responsibilities can go somewhere useful now, especially if you approach them as joint problem-solving. If single, you may feel drawn to people who seem emotionally steady and practically minded, perhaps met through neighbourhood activities, real-estate matters, or home-related errands. Don’t overlook quieter connections that feel safe rather than immediately thrilling.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 2nd continues to support gradual financial growth, but today’s focus is on how your home life influences your spending. The Virgo Moon encourages you to track household expenses, compare utilities or services, and identify small changes that would bring down stress. An organised kitchen or workspace might indirectly reduce food delivery or impulse purchases. Aim for clarity instead of drastic cuts; knowing the real numbers often calms anxiety on its own.

🧘 Advice: Use your analytical gifts to design a kinder environment for yourself. When your space reflects your current mind, your choices naturally improve.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Change your daily setting by even 10%, and you may find your thoughts, relationships and decisions quietly shifting with it.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, moves through Virgo in Hasta in your 3rd house, stimulating communication, planning and local connections. The Sun in Purva Phalguni in Leo emphasises your 2nd house of resources and voice, while Ketu in early Leo quietly detaches you from old patterns around money and self-worth. Jupiter remains strong in your sign, and retrograde Saturn in Pisces steadies your 9th house of belief and long-range vision. The overall tone favours thoughtful conversations about value—what is truly worth your time, energy and words.

💼 Career: With the Moon and exalted Mercury energising your 3rd, your mental processing and organisational capacity are high. This is a good day for drafting proposals, improving documentation, preparing talks or training material, or tackling a pile of emails with unusual clarity. The Leo Sun in your 2nd helps you project confidence when discussing your contributions or fees. Consider reviewing how you present your skills to others—bio, CV, portfolio, or even how you introduce yourself in meetings. Refining language now could open doors over the coming weeks.

❤️ Love: The 2nd–3rd activation makes words especially powerful. If partnered, speaking kindly but directly about finances, schedules or shared projects brings more relief than walking on eggshells. Practice listening fully before responding; you may hear an unspoken worry or hope. If single, conversations—whether in person, online, or via messages—carry extra charge. You might be drawn to someone whose mind feels precise and grounding. Paying attention to how you feel after interacting with someone (clearer or more confused?) is a helpful guide.

💰 Money: The Sun in your 2nd can illuminate both strengths and blind spots around money. You might see more clearly where you undervalue yourself or where pride nudges you toward unnecessary spending. The Virgo Moon supports practical steps: creating or updating a budget, checking for redundant subscriptions, or mapping out payments over the next month. Jupiter in your 1st favours decisions that protect your long-term wellbeing, not just immediate comfort.

🧘 Advice: Let clarity be your act of self-care today. The more precisely you name your needs and numbers, the less room there is for quiet anxiety.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The sentence you finally say out loud about what you’re worth may become the line you never again agree to cross.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Sun shines powerfully in your own sign in Purva Phalguni, highlighting personal identity and visibility, while Ketu in early Leo in Magha continues to shed outdated ego roles. The Moon in Virgo in Hasta moves through your 2nd house of resources, voice and self-esteem. Venus in Libra in Swati blesses your 3rd house with charm in communication, and Jupiter travels through Cancer in your 12th, expanding inner growth. Today’s pattern asks: how do you want to be seen, and how will you support that version of yourself materially and emotionally?

💼 Career: With the Sun in your 1st, your presence is noticed—people look to you for direction, warmth and confidence. The Virgo Moon in your 2nd, though, calls for practical follow-through. This is an excellent day to back up bold ideas with clear numbers and realistic plans: hours, costs, timelines, and resources. Venus in your 3rd grants you persuasive speech, which can be used to negotiate better conditions, pitch a concept, or smooth over previous misunderstandings. Aim to match your promises to what you can sustainably deliver; that alignment will strengthen your reputation.

❤️ Love: You’re likely more aware of how you show up in relationships—what you give, what you expect, and what actually nourishes you. If partnered, conversations about money, shared values or future purchases may surface; treat them as an opportunity to co-create rather than win. Small gestures of appreciation, especially verbal ones, go far today. If single, you may find yourself drawn to people who respect your individuality and also encourage you to manage your life well. The mix of confidence and groundedness is especially attractive right now, in yourself and others.

💰 Money: Today is ideal for practical financial steps. The Moon in your 2nd supports reviewing budgets, reconsidering what you charge, or deciding which expenses truly reflect your priorities. Jupiter in your 12th invites generosity but also awareness of subtle leaks—supporting others is admirable, but not if it consistently leaves you depleted. Consider setting a clear limit for how much time or money you offer without compromising your own stability.

🧘 Advice: Let your self-respect guide your choices more than momentary pride. Strength today looks like aligning your lifestyle with the person you know you’re becoming.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: When you treat your time, energy and money as royal resources, you naturally stop spending them on anything that keeps you small.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves through your own sign in mid-Virgo in Hasta, joining exalted Mercury in Uttara Phalguni, both in your 1st house. Sun in Leo with Ketu in early Leo activates your 12th house, dissolving outdated fears, habits and hidden stories. Jupiter in Cancer lights up your 11th house of communities and aspirations, while retrograde Saturn in Pisces continues to refine your 7th house of partnership. Today, your mind, heart and body are unusually aligned for self-observation and course correction.

💼 Career: With the Moon and Mercury together in your sign, your problem-solving abilities and attention to detail are sharp. This is one of those days when you can untangle complex tasks, spot inefficiencies, and map out a realistic, step-by-step strategy. Consider reviewing ongoing projects: where are you over-functioning, and where can you simplify or delegate? Sun–Ketu in the 12th suggest clearing old work habits like over-preparing, constant checking, or invisible labour that no one has agreed on. Make at least one boundary or process more explicit; your future self will thank you.

❤️ Love: Self-awareness colours your relationships today. If partnered, you may notice how your desire to help sometimes crosses into quiet resentment when others don’t reciprocate in the way you expect. Rather than withdrawing, try stating one concrete need or preference in a clear, non-dramatic way. If single, your discernment is heightened; you’re less easily distracted by superficial charm and more interested in whether someone’s life actually works. Encounters through groups, professional circles, or shared interests could feel promising if they respect your need for order and honesty.

💰 Money: The 1st–12th axis activated suggests that financial decisions are linked to self-worth and subconscious patterns. Notice where you might be spending to manage anxiety or to meet an internal standard of “being prepared.” Some safeguards are wise; others simply weigh you down. The Virgo energy helps you edit: keep what genuinely supports your stability and release what you’ve outgrown. Jupiter in your 11th supports long-term saving or investing in goals connected to community, technology, or collective projects.

🧘 Advice: Treat today as a personal audit, not a trial. Use what you learn about yourself to make adjustments, not accusations.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The standard you quietly update for how you organise your own life becomes the invisible contract others must meet to stay in it.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta moves through your 12th house of rest, intuition and release, while exalted Mercury there in Uttara Phalguni turns introspection into clear insight. The Sun in Leo with Ketu in early Leo activates your 11th house of friendships and long-term aims. Venus, your ruler, travels strongly through Libra in Swati in your 1st house, heightening charm and self-awareness. You’re simultaneously visible and inwardly selective about which connections and ambitions truly fit you now.

💼 Career: Outwardly, you may be involved with groups, teams or networks, but a part of you wants to step back and observe the dynamics. This is a good day for quietly evaluating which professional associations, platforms or projects still resonate and which feel draining or off-course. Virgo energy in your 12th supports behind-the-scenes work: research, strategy, closing out lingering tasks, or cleaning digital and mental clutter. With Venus in your 1st, you can diplomatically reposition yourself—gently reframe your role or limits—without creating unnecessary friction.

❤️ Love: You’re attractive to others now, but your emotional body craves softness, privacy and sincerity. If partnered, you might prefer a low-key evening of honest conversation, shared music, or simply being together without expectations. Old stories or memories could arise; treat them as information, not as fate. If single, your intuition about potential partners is sharper than usual. Pay attention to what your body feels after an interaction—tension, ease, expansion? Trust that subtle data more than polished words.

💰 Money: The 11th–12th axis raises questions about how your financial life aligns with your long-term hopes. Do certain social circles or goals encourage overspending or comparison? Are there quiet leaks—fees, unused memberships, recurring contributions—that no longer match your values? Today favours reviewing those and gently phasing out what doesn’t serve you. Jupiter in Cancer at the top of your chart still supports career growth, so prioritise choices that free time and funds for real opportunities rather than image maintenance.

🧘 Advice: Allow yourself to be selectively available. You don’t have to attend every invitation, online or offline, to maintain your worth.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The space you protect from other people’s expectations today becomes the sanctuary where your next true desire is born.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta lights up your 11th house of friends, networks and future plans, while exalted Mercury there in Uttara Phalguni supports strategic thinking with allies. The Sun in Leo with Ketu in Magha continues to move through your 10th house of career and status, keeping your public role in an active reshaping phase. Mars, your traditional ruler, at late Gemini in Punarvasu energises your 8th house of shared resources and psychological depth. The tone is oriented toward collaborations and choices that reshape your trajectory.

💼 Career: The 10th–11th emphasis makes today important for professional positioning. You may realise that certain responsibilities or titles no longer match who you are—or who you’re becoming. Use the Virgo Moon’s clarity to list what you actually want from your work in the next 1–3 years, then see which connections could realistically support that shift. Conversations with mentors, peers, or online communities can be fruitful if you ask specific, grounded questions. Mars in the 8th favours dealing with complex or confidential matters; just avoid letting frustration push you into ultimatums. Measured, well-prepared moves are more powerful now than dramatic leaps.

❤️ Love: Relationships are likely filtered through the lens of your broader life direction. If partnered, you may feel called to discuss how career changes, relocations, or financial decisions intertwine with your bond. Approach these talks from a place of shared problem-solving rather than control; you’re better served by transparency than by silent strategising. If single, attraction may arise in group spaces, professional associations, or among people who share an intense interest or cause with you. Intellectual and emotional honesty will be more magnetic than superficial charm.

💰 Money: Mars in your 8th continues to activate joint finances, debts, taxes or inheritances. The Virgo Moon in your 11th suggests evaluating shared investments, group ventures or long-term financial goals with a clear, critical eye. Are current agreements moving you toward the future you actually want? If not, consider initiating a calm conversation about adjustments. Jupiter in Cancer in your 9th supports seeking expert advice or education about complex matters instead of trying to shoulder everything alone.

🧘 Advice: Let strategy replace anxiety. When you convert vague worries into concrete plans, your natural power has somewhere productive to go.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The honest question you ask an ally today could uncover a pathway that’s been waiting for your courage to notice it.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta climbs through your 10th house of career and public role, joined by exalted Mercury in Uttara Phalguni. The Sun in Leo with Ketu in Magha still powers your 9th house of beliefs, travel and higher learning, while Jupiter, your ruler, is exalted in Cancer in the 8th, deepening your transformation around trust and shared resources. This is a day when your ideals and your responsibilities want to talk to each other.

💼 Career: This is one of the more practically potent days for your work this month. The Virgo Moon–Mercury combo at the top of your chart supports clear planning, composed communication with superiors or clients, and careful attention to detail. Feedback about your performance or role may arrive—formal or informal. Instead of reacting defensively or triumphantly, mine it for actionable information. Sun–Ketu in your 9th may nudge you to refine an educational path, philosophical stance, or long-term professional direction. Consider which trainings, certifications or experiences would genuinely support both your income and your need for meaning.

❤️ Love: With much of the sky emphasising 9th, 10th and 8th houses, relationships may feel closely linked to life direction. If partnered, honest discussion about how each of you envisions the coming years—geography, work, family, financial risk—can prevent misunderstandings later. You don’t have to have all the answers; making the questions mutual is already progress. If single, you may be drawn to people you respect professionally, teachers, or individuals you meet through study, spiritual spaces, or deep transformational work. Take it slowly; shared values are more important now than quick chemistry.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 8th continues to highlight shared funds, investments, and psychological patterns around having and owing. The Virgo Moon in your 10th supports careful review of contracts, job offers, or performance-linked pay. Ask yourself: what kind of financial structure would let me act with integrity and enthusiasm? Avoid pressure to jump into big commitments without time to read the fine print; your long-term freedom depends more on the terms you agree to than on headline numbers.

🧘 Advice: Aim your optimism through a lens of precision. When your big vision is translated into concrete steps, others are far more likely to support it.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The responsible choice you make for your reputation today can quietly expand the horizon of what’s possible tomorrow.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta moves through your 9th house of perspective, learning and long-distance matters, while exalted Mercury there in Uttara Phalguni supports thoughtful study and planning. The Sun in Leo with Ketu in Magha continues to stir your 8th house of shared resources and emotional depth, and Saturn, your ruler, is retrograde in Pisces in your 3rd, asking for deliberate, careful communication. Jupiter in Cancer in your 7th highlights the importance of wise partners and advisors. Today’s current urges you to zoom out and rethink the frameworks guiding your choices.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for strategic thinking about where your work is heading. The 8th–9th emphasis suggests that major changes you’re considering—career pivots, new markets, collaborations—require both courage and information. Use the Virgo Moon to research, compare, and break large ideas into manageable actions. Conversations with mentors, coaches, or experienced colleagues could be particularly useful if you come prepared with specific questions. Saturn in your 3rd reminds you to pace yourself: better to write one excellent, carefully worded email than scatter your attention across many half-finished tasks.

❤️ Love: With Jupiter in your 7th, partnerships can be sources of support and perspective—even when they challenge you. If partnered, honest dialogues about shared goals, travel, education, or spiritual interests can bring you closer. You might see more clearly where your cautious nature has been protective and where it has held you back from growth together. If single, meaningful connections may arise through classes, workshops, travel planning, or spiritual communities. You’re likely more attracted to sincerity and emotional intelligence than to superficial flash.

💰 Money: Sun–Ketu in your 8th invites a review of joint finances, inheritances, taxes or loans. The Virgo Moon in your 9th suggests learning more about the systems that govern these areas—reading, attending a webinar, or consulting a professional. Rather than fearing what you don’t know, let curiosity lead. Small steps, like organising relevant documents or making a list of questions, can reduce the sense of overwhelm and position you for better decisions later.

🧘 Advice: Let inquiry replace assumption. The more you’re willing to update your understanding, the less trapped you’ll feel by old financial or emotional stories.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The belief you refine about what’s possible for you may alter your future more than any single decision you make today.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon in Virgo in Hasta moves through your 8th house of intimacy, shared resources and deep psychological material, while exalted Mercury there in Uttara Phalguni helps you name complexities with unusual clarity. The Sun in Leo with Ketu in Magha opposes you from the 7th house of partnership, keeping close relationships in a refining process. Rahu in early Aquarius in Dhanishtha continues to push you toward personal reinvention, while retrograde Saturn in Pisces in your 2nd insists on grounded, sustainable use of money and speech.

💼 Career: Work relationships, contracts and long-term collaborations are highlighted. The 7th–8th axis encourages you to look beneath surface agreements: Who carries which risks? What expectations are unspoken? Today is ideal for asking clarifying questions about roles, compensation, or timelines. The Virgo Moon supports detailed review of documents or budgets, while your Aquarian side can see the broader pattern. If you’ve been feeling the urge to break away from a partnership or client, consider first whether renegotiation could serve you better than abrupt endings.

❤️ Love: Emotional intensity rises, but so does your ability to analyse it. If partnered, topics like trust, transparency, shared resources or deeper emotional needs may come to the fore. Speaking in specific, observable terms—“When X happens, I feel Y, and I need Z”—will be more effective than general criticism. If single, you might feel less interested in casual interactions and more drawn to people willing to talk about real life: values, history, healing. Encounters could arise in therapeutic spaces, financial or legal contexts, or through friends who share more of their own journey.

💰 Money: With Saturn in your 2nd and today’s Moon in the 8th, financial responsibility is a central theme. It’s a favourable day to review debts, joint accounts, subscriptions and shared financial plans. Look for ways to simplify or consolidate rather than to add new layers of complexity. Rahu in your 1st may tempt you toward speculative risks, but the current sky rewards steady, well-thought-out moves more than gambles. A small, realistic plan for repayment, saving, or boundary-setting can ease pressure surprisingly quickly.

🧘 Advice: Courage today looks like turning toward the topics you usually postpone. What you unpack calmly now will have less power to unsettle you later.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The boundary you set around time, money or emotional labour today can quietly recalibrate every relationship built on old assumptions.
pisces:

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The simple arrangement you refine with someone today can turn everyday friction into a steady sense of being on the same side.
